notes.title: Playtest 1.2
notes.content:
Changes to previous versions:

- There is now a message telling to those with more than one monitor that there might be a bug problem, and how to fix it.
- You can also choose your screen now.
- Tutorial messages have been reworked a lot, hopefully now new players will get the idea of how to play the game and not get stuck because of not taking HP Upgrade.
- There is now settings menu in MAP screen too (Ugly, but works for now)
- You can also choose to lower your difficulty from MAP settings. (next update will have an option to actually choose difficulty level when you start the game, didn't make it to this one yet).
- Bonus Simulations are now colored different in map from rest of the simulations.
- Hopefully fixed the problem of incorrectly calculating if player failed several times in a row or not (fix is untested)

- Once upon a time there was a twitch streamer called Giza666, and she really wanted to see how the story of the game would end, but ah, alas! When you have a skill issue, try as you might, she just couldn't get it done but was miserably stuck in a certain simulation. This simulation has now been updated and made slightly easier based on the playlog.txt she sent me. This, plus the possibility to lower the difficulty and this way get even 2 more upgrades more with her save file, will surely make it a breeze for her to get through now.

- Thanks to all the other streamers too: Plabs_, SpoonyPlays, MentalDefenestration, Grasshyren, Cifex, all your playtests and your audience helped shape this update, although some stuff are still only coming. (hope I didn't miss any)

Notice to those using old save files to continue playing with this one:
You might, or more likely, will, see some tutorial messages you have no use to anymore. This is because I went with assumption that people play from beginning, and hence see them in right spots, but if you continue old save file, you might see them when replaying old simulations for example.

notes.title: Playtest 1.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where more survived robots were only transferring one simulation forward, instead of increasing start amount on all further simulations by the survived amount.

Added one Tutorial message after level 3 in hopes of making players understand the idea of replaying levels better.

Now when Simulation/level description shows, moving mouse over one of the other missions wont change the display text anymore. while this had its uses, it seemed to confuse players mostly.

Added blinking to tutorial highlight rectangles.
